evidence.quote: Previous work on gyro modeling is based on computing the Allan variance of a gyro signal
the theoretical variance of the Allan variance and the covariance between different Allan variance points.
The algorithm is developed using the formulation of the best linear unbiased estimator from statistical estimation theory.
The performance of the algorithm is demonstrated using simulated and experimental data.
